info.name: JobPilot API — Full Automation
info.description:
🤖 Run this collection top-to-bottom using Postman Runner.

It tests ALL endpoints in the correct order, chaining variables automatically.

**Setup:** Import the environment file first, ensure server is running on {{baseUrl}}.

**Run Order:**
1. Health → 2. Auth → 3. Profile → 4. Jobs → 5. Applications → 6. Resumes → 7. AI → 8. Cleanup

**What's mocked:**
- Resume PDF URL (placeholder URL, no real file generated)
- AI scoring requires GROK_API_KEY in .env (gracefully returns null without it)
- Job insights requires GROK_API_KEY

**What's REAL:**
- Auth (register/login/refresh/logout/change-password)
- Profile CRUD with full data
- Job sync from Remotive + Arbeitnow (real external APIs)
- Job search, filter, pagination
- Application CRUD, status tracking, notes
- Token blocklist (logout invalidates tokens immediately)
